description_en: Performs asset-related Q&A through the SSE interface of MetaAgent
description_zh: MetaAgent 资产问答 SSE 接口
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise asset-answer-sse --query '帮我找一下用户表' --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssetAnswerSSE

parameters.help_en: The database ID. This parameter is optional. If specified, the Q&A is performed within the specified database. If not specified, the Q&A is performed at the tenant level across all databases. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html operation to obtain the database ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据库ID，可选。传入时在指定库内问答；不传时为租户级跨库全局问答。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html接口获取
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en: The natural language question from the user
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The name of the model to use. Only Qwen series models are supported
parameters.help_zh: 选用的模型名称，仅可用千问系列
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: The request ID for the current Q&A round. This value is used in the requestId field of SSE events
parameters.help_zh: 本轮问答请求ID，用于 SSE 事件中的 requestId 字段
parameters.name: query_id

parameters.help_en: The session ID. This parameter is used to associate context across multiple conversation rounds
parameters.help_zh: 会话ID，用于多轮对话上下文关联
parameters.name: session_id

200.description_en: SSE 流式返回，每行格式为 data: {json}\n\n。正常流式为 requestId/output；RAM 鉴权失败时为 POP 标准错误体（含 AccessDeniedDetail）

schema.description_en: The response is returned in SSE streaming format. Each line follows the format data: {json}\n\n. Normal streaming responses contain requestId/output. If RAM authentication fails, a standard POP error body is returned, which includes AccessDeniedDetail
